name: Origlyph Curated Seed Dataset & Source Manifest
description: Curated cultural heritage seed records with verified coordinate anchors, source attribution, and rights statements. Demonstrates the provenance graph and progressive hint framework.

institutions.name: Staatliche Museen zu Berlin / Neues Museum
institutions.license_policy: Public Domain for historical objects; photo attribution required

internet_archive.strategy: Use the Internet Archive Advanced Search API (query: mediatype:image AND (subject:cultural-heritage OR collection:metropolitanmuseumofart-gallery)) to retrieve item identifiers, download Dublin Core XML or JSON metadata, normalize spatial subject tags (coverage/spatial) into decimal latitude/longitude, and map into the Origlyph schema.

wikimedia_commons.strategy: Query Wikidata SPARQL endpoints for cultural heritage instances (P31/wd:Q839954 or P31/wd:Q3305213) with coordinates (P625), link to Commons media files (P18), and ingest verified licenses (P275).
